name: Documents a shipped change

item_template.title: [DOC] Document the CSV export
item_template.description: The reports page can export the current view as CSV. Document it where this repository keeps its user-facing documentation.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when a reader looks for export, then they find what it does and one worked example.

judge_criteria: The summary names the documentation file it changed.
The summary says it checked its claims against the source rather than the task description.

notes: Documentation that restates the ticket rather than the code is how a doc becomes untrue on the day it is written. The second criterion is the one that catches it.

name: Asks when there is nothing to document
notes: With no named change there is nothing to describe. A done here means it wrote documentation for something it chose, which nobody reviewed and nobody shipped.

name: Documents without changing the code

item_template.title: [DOC] Document the slug helper
item_template.description: A helper turns titles into URL-safe slugs. Document it where this repository documents its utilities.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the documentation, when a reader looks for the helper, then they find what it does and one example.

notes: A writer that edits the code to match what it wrote has made the documentation true by changing the product, and the change rides in with no test behind it.
